tournament.name: Torneio do Weber - Tix Pro Top 8

decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing efficient creatures like Goblin Tomb Raider and Voldaren Epicure, alongside removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total while maintaining board control. Faithless Looting and Deadly Dispute help with card selection and resource management, while cards like Alms of the Vein provide additional reach. The deck's mana base consists of artifact lands and utility lands to ensure smooth casting of spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total by playing aggressive creatures and damaging spells. Mono Black Aggro emphasizes on using low-cost creatures and removal spells to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. By efficiently using mana and maximizing damage output, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize or gain control. Additionally, the deck includes card draw spells and lifegain effects to maintain card advantage and sustain its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a swarm of aggressive red creatures and burn spells. By playing low-cost creatures like Reckless Lackey and Goblin Tomb Raider, the deck aims to quickly build a wide board presence. Cards like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt provide direct damage to finish off opponents or remove threats. The deck also includes ways to generate additional creatures like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Bushwhacker to maintain pressure. The goal is to win the game before opponents have a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this Orzhov Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently control the board while applying pressure to the opponent. By utilizing efficient removal spells like Cast Down and Unmake, along with aggressive creatures like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and win through combat damage. The deck also includes card advantage and lifegain elements to ensure longevity in the game. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent in order to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing low-cost creatures like Goblin Tomb Raider, Goblin Blast-Runner, and Voldaren Epicure to deal early damage. Cards like Goblin Bushwhacker and Kuldotha Rebirth help to increase the board presence quickly. Burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Galvanic Blast, and Chain Lightning provide reach and removal. Implement of Combustion and Experimental Synthesizer offer additional damage sources. Seal of Fire can be used as a versatile removal spell. The mana base consists of mostly Mountains and Great Furnaces to ensure consistent red mana production.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost aggressive creatures and burn spells. By using cards like Reckless Lackey, Goblin Bushwhacker, and Voldaren Epicure, along with efficient removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to reduce the opponent's life total as fast as possible. The inclusion of cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Chain Lightning provide additional reach and versatility, allowing for multiple paths to victory. With a streamlined mana base focused on Mountains and Great Furnaces, this deck is designed for maximum speed and consistency in a Pauper format.

The key idea of the Mono Blue Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost creatures like Delver of Secrets, Faerie Miscreant, and Ninja of the Deep Hours, supported by spell-based disruption such as Spellstutter Sprite and Counterspell. The deck aims to maintain control of the board with efficient counterspells and removal while pushing damage through with evasive creatures. The inclusion of cards like Mutagenic Growth and Force Spike adds further versatility and disruption to the deck's game plan, allowing it to adapt to different matchups and strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to create a powerful synergy between sacrificing Goblins, generating mana, and drawing cards to fuel a combo win condition. By utilizing cards like Skirk Prospector, Putrid Goblin, and Deadly Dispute, the deck aims to create a loop of sacrificing and reanimating Goblins while generating mana and card advantage. With cards like Mesmeric Fiend and Dark-Dweller Oracle to disrupt the opponent's strategy, this combo-centric Goblin deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of sacrifices and explosive plays.

This deck focuses on using control elements along with Gates to create a strong defense while generating card advantage. Sacred Cat and Squadron Hawk provide early defense, while Counterspell and Prismatic Strands control the board. The Gates provide mana fixing and ramp, allowing for more powerful spells to be cast. The deck aims to control the game until it can establish a strong board presence with cards like Guardian of the Guildpact and The Modern Age. Overall, the deck combines control elements with Gates for a versatile and powerful strategy.

The deck focuses on using flicker effects to repeatedly trigger enter-the-battlefield effects of creatures like Augur of Bolas and Mulldrifter, generating card advantage and value. It also utilizes counter spells and removal to control the board while setting up the combo. The synergy between flicker effects and powerful creatures allows the deck to outvalue opponents and maintain control of the game. With a mix of card draw, removal, and creature recursion, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a strong board presence and constant pressure.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells. By overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of small but efficient threats, the deck aims to finish the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize or mount a defense. With a mix of creatures and direct damage spells, the deck seeks to maintain pressure and force the opponent to react defensively, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The core strategy of this UR Control deck is to maintain board control through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and creature denial. The deck is focused on disrupting the opponent's game plan while also generating card advantage and tempo with cards like Augur of Bolas and Ponder. The inclusion of Murmuring Mystic and Azure Fleet Admiral provides additional win conditions and board presence. By carefully managing resources and using a mix of permission and threats, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver its opponent in a grindy, attrition-based game.

The deck focuses on using walls with defender abilities to generate mana and protect yourself while assembling a combo that allows you to generate infinite mana and win the game. The key cards include Axebane Guardian and Overgrown Battlement for mana generation, along with Freed from the Real for the infinite mana combo. The deck also includes cards like Lead the Stampede and Winding Way to help find your combo pieces quickly. With the right setup, you can overwhelm your opponent with a massive amount of mana and win the game in a single turn.

This deck focuses on flooding the board with small, efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Squadron Hawk and Battle Screech to generate additional bodies, along with pump spells like Guardians' Pledge, the deck can quickly amass a formidable army. The inclusion of disruptive creatures like Icatian Javelineers and removal spells like Journey to Nowhere helps to control the battlefield and clear the way for the aggressive white creatures to finish off the opponent. The deck aims to win through sheer numbers and efficient combat tricks.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost white creatures, utilizing cards like Novice Inspector, Squadron Hawk, and Kor Skyfisher to maintain board presence. By using cards like Militia Bugler and Prismatic Strands for additional utility, combined with the pump spells Guardians' Pledge and Recommission, the deck aims to quickly build a wide board and overpower the opponent with an aggressive strategy. Journey to Nowhere provides removal to deal with problematic creatures, while Idyllic Grange helps provide additional mana fixing for the deck's white-heavy composition.

The main focus of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive strategy by playing low-cost creatures and powering them up with enchantments. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats and buffs while also having access to protection and countermagic to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By consistently applying pressure and maintaining a strong board presence, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.
